messages:
Hannah Lee: Heads up  since ~04:40 UTC were seeing onboarding callbacks rejected with 401/403 for Private (VPC) tenants. Affected: auth tokens used for webhook signing were failing after a recent KMS/HSM key rotation. Ive pulled 11 affected tenants, including 2 trials near expiry. Need a customer-facing status, manual replay plan, and renewal-risk triage. @Diego can you draft a short note?

Diego Alvarez: Drafting now. Will be concise, empathetic, action-first.

Diego Alvarez: Hi <Customer>  we detected failed onboarding activations for your Private deployment due to temporary webhook authentication failures after an internal key rotation. Weve reverted the rotation for affected VPCs and applied a fix; activations should resume. If your trial is expiring soon or you want an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and well prioritize. We will follow up with an RCA and propose credits if SLA thresholds were met.  Diego, Redwood CS

Priya Nair: Tone and next steps look good. Add: "If you received duplicate payloads, well include an Idempotency-Key header and guidance to avoid double-processing." Also request customers confirm webhook secret rotation schedule if they manage endpoint verification.

Diego Alvarez: Added idempotency note and trial pause option.

Hannah Lee: Tech update: root cause = KMS service rotated signing key before rolling out verifier updates to vpc-egress agents. Some agents used cached key material and produced tokens that downstream endpoints rejected. Ive deployed a scoped rollback and hotpatch to refresh verifier caches; replay queue draining should begin within ~510min.

ops-bot: [action] revert/kms-rotation-scope applied by Hannah Lee  job=kr-5531 status=success nodes=18

Priya Nair: ETA for backlog drain? Any risk of token reuse or security exposure?

Hannah Lee: Backlog drain ETA ~2060min per tenant depending on queue. No credential leakage detected; tokens were invalidated by verifier mismatch, not exposed. Replays will include a signed Idempotency-Key header to help customers dedupe.

Diego Alvarez: Ill send the customer batches in two waves so we can monitor responses. Also adding a short note for renewal owners: mark tenants with activation >48h or trials expiring within 72h as "renewal-watch" and prepare tailored outreach.

Priya Nair: Ill prepare the renewal-owner script and flag the accounts in CRM. Also schedule 30min office hours at 10:15 UTC for any customers who want live help. Who can join for replays? Hannah?

Hannah Lee: I can join 10:1510:45 UTC with logs and the patch summary.

Legal-Bot: [notice] Suggested credit wording for initial comms: "We will evaluate credit eligibility based on SLA impact and will follow up with a proposal as appropriate." Pre-approved.

Diego Alvarez: Nice. Message Im sending to first batch: ```Hi there  we detected onboarding activations failing for your Private deployment due to webhook authentication errors after an internal key rotation. Weve applied a fix and expect activations to resume within 2060 minutes. If your trial expires soon or youd like a manual replay sooner, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and well prioritize. We will follow up with a technical RCA and credit proposal if SLA thresholds apply.  Diego, Redwood CS```

Hannah Lee: Internal replay steps for CS/Enablement:
```
# manual replay
1) POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: replay-{ts}-{tenant_id}"
2) tail logs: kubectl -n vpc-{tenant_id} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
3) confirm delivery: SELECT status, response_code, ts FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
4) if downstream rejects with 401/403, ask customer to temporarily accept rotated tokens or provide an updated verifier public key
```

Priya Nair: CRM action: tagging affected tenants as "kms-webhook-auth-failure" and adding renewal-watch flags for trials <72h. Ill also attach the office-hours invite and the replay KB link.

Diego Alvarez: Sending wave 1 now. Will monitor replies and surface any customers asking for expedited replays. Adding a one-question feedback pulse to follow-up: "Did the replay and communication meet your needs? Yes/No + comment"

ops-bot: [notice] replay-jobs queued: tenants=11 job=replay-kms-4843 status=queued

Hannah Lee: Replays started; first confirmations show 200 responses. No evidence of duplicate processing. Posting telemetry + token validation timeline to RCA doc later today.

Priya Nair: Action items recap: Diego send comms (in progress), Hannah full RCA + telemetry (ETA EOD), Priya renewal-owner scripts + CRM flags (in progress), Legal bot credit wording noted. Ill assemble exec summary and handover to renewals. Add any other items here.
